info.title: Banzami Sandbox API
info.description: Machine-readable description of the Banzami Developer API as served by the Public Sandbox — one developer platform, two financial environments. The Sandbox is self-service and uses fictitious value. Financial LIVE is NOT READY: it requires institutional approval and is fail-closed — bz_live_ keys are refused and no Live key can be issued from the Sandbox. PT docs: developers.banzami.com/docs · EN docs: developers.banzami.com/docs/en. Every operation described is served by the deployed Sandbox gateway; an operation a developer key cannot call says so and names the refusal it answers. Each operation names the scope it requires in x-banzami-scope (null for a route that takes no API key). POST /v1/payment-links/{id}/mark-used is retired (410 ROUTE_RETIRED) and is not described. All example values are obvious placeholders (bz_test_sk_XXXX, idem_xxx, payment_session_xxx, bzst_xxx) — never real credentials.

get.summary: Key identity (first successful call — no SDK required)
get.description: Returns the authenticated key's environment, the Project it belongs to ({id, name, ref}), its scopes and status. Requires the identity:read scope. Returns no financial state — see GET /v1/financial-setup. bz_live_ keys are rejected fail-closed.

Whether the Project this key belongs to can settle and, if not, exactly what is missing. The key is the authority: nothing in the request names a Project, owner or account. Every field is decided with the rules settlement itself enforces — settlement.ready is true exactly when settlement's prerequisites pass, and each blocker is the refusal a settlement would return. A Project not yet configured answers 200 with financial_setup.state UNCONFIGURED and the blocker FINANCIAL_SETUP_NOT_CONFIGURED. Requires the identity:read scope. SDK: getFinancialSetup().

parameters.name: fee_destination
parameters.description: A @banza to evaluate as the fee destination instead of the Project's own.

403.description: Missing identity:read scope

409.description: The Project's financial setup does not match an account Banzami holds. Not fixable by the caller.

example.message: this project's financial setup does not match an account; contact support

503.description: Readiness could not be evaluated right now. Never reported as missing configuration; retry.

post.description: Creates a payment session and returns its id, status and interfaces (link/QR). Credential: developer key with the payment_sessions scope on a project with an ACTIVE binding, or a merchant credential.

get.description: Lists the project's payment sessions, newest first, optionally filtered by status. There is no cursor: the response is the most recent sessions up to limit. A limit outside 1–200 is replaced by the default.

get.summary: Fetch the session's public payment link

404.description: Session has no payment link (code NO_LINK) or session not found

get.summary: Fetch the session QR (JSON value or rendered image)
get.description: The session QR encodes the session's hosted pay URL (https://pay.banzami.com/pay/{slug}), for a fixed-amount session as for an open-amount one: any phone camera opens the pay page, where the payer pays. (A fixed-amount session used to encode a structured dynamic-QR payload that no route could pay; it is no longer returned.) Without parameters, returns the encodable value as JSON. With ?format=png|svg, returns the rendered image; ?format=pdf answers 415.

post.description: Creates a payment link with a public slug (pay.banzami.com/pay/{slug}). Omit amount_minor for an open-amount link. Credential: merchant credential, or developer key with the payment_links scope on a project with an ACTIVE binding.

next_cursor.description: Present when another page may follow.

400.description: limit outside 1–100, or a cursor that is not a previous next_cursor (INVALID_PARAM)

get.description: Lists the project's payment links, newest first, a page at a time. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page; its absence means the last page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, unchanged.

post.summary: Open a segregated account under your owner
post.description: Opens a wallet account beneath the financial owner your project is bound to. Credential: developer key with wallet_accounts:create, or a merchant credential. The owner is always derived server-side; a client-supplied wallet is refused.

400.description: Validation error, or a client-supplied wallet (PAYEE_NOT_ALLOWED)

403.description: Missing wallet_accounts:create scope, or project not provisioned

get.summary: List the accounts under your wallet
get.description: With a developer key the listing is scoped to your project's bound wallet and a wallet_id parameter is refused. With a merchant credential, wallet_id names the wallet you own. Requires wallet_accounts:read.

parameters.name: wallet_id
parameters.description: Merchant credential only; refused for a developer key.

403.description: Missing wallet_accounts:read scope

get.description: Returns the account when it belongs to your owner. An account belonging to another owner returns 404 rather than 403: a status code that distinguished them would let one project enumerate another's accounts. Requires wallet_accounts:read.

404.description: Unknown account, or one belonging to another owner

post.summary: Move value between two accounts of your own owner
post.description: Transferências (BANZA ADR-052). Moves value between two wallet accounts of the financial owner your project is bound to. Nothing crosses the owner boundary: it is not a payout, not an application settlement, not consumer P2P. Credential: developer key with transfers:write. Both endpoints are validated against the caller’s owner in the gateway and again in Core; an account outside it answers 404, indistinguishable from one that does not exist.

201.description: Transfer completed. Replaying the same idempotency_key returns this same transfer.

400.description: INVALID_DESTINATION (same account), INVALID_AMOUNT (zero or negative), MISSING_FIELD, INVALID_CURRENCY

403.description: Missing transfers:write scope, or project not provisioned to hold funds

404.description: An account outside your owner — indistinguishable from one that does not exist

409.description: The same idempotency_key reused with a different request

post.summary: Register the endpoint that receives your project’s events
post.description: Registers an HTTPS endpoint under the owner your project is bound to. The signing secret is returned exactly once, in this response, and is never readable again. Credential: developer key with webhooks:write. Deliveries are signed over the raw request bytes and carry the banza-signature header.

201.description: Endpoint registered. The secret appears here and nowhere else.

400.description: INVALID_WEBHOOK_URL (not a public https destination) or UNSUPPORTED_EVENT

403.description: Missing webhooks:write scope, or project not provisioned

404.description: Another project’s endpoint

get.description: Lists every endpoint registered under the owner your project is bound to, newest first, including deactivated ones (active: false). The signing secret is never included. Credential: developer key with webhooks:read, or a merchant credential. No pagination.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing webhooks:read) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (project not provisioned — an unbound project has no webhooks)

post.description: Returns an eligible payment fully or partially. The refund debits the account that RECEIVED the payment, not the owner’s general balance. Credential: developer key with refunds:write, or a merchant credential. Another project’s payment answers 404 — knowing an id is not authority over it.

201.description: Refund created. Replaying the same idempotency_key returns this same refund.

400.description: Currency differs from the source, amount above the accrued cap, or missing fields

403.description: Missing refunds:write scope — a read-only key cannot refund

404.description: Refund source not found, or belonging to another project

get.description: Lists the refunds of the owner your project is bound to, newest first. The owner comes from the credential; no parameter selects another. Credential: developer key with refunds:read on a project bound to a financial owner, or a merchant credential. There is no cursor: at most limit refunds are returned.

parameters.name: source_id
parameters.description: Only the refunds of this payment. Must be the payment's id; a value that is not a UUID is ignored rather than refused, and the unfiltered list is returned.

400.description: INVALID_PARAM — limit is not an integer between 1 and 100

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing refunds:read) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (project not provisioned to hold funds)

post.summary: Settle one of your segregated accounts to a beneficiary
post.description: Closes out a segregated wallet account (for example a CAMPAIGN account) of the owner your project is bound to. Banzami reads the account's available balance as the gross, prices it with the pricing profile Banzami assigned to your business, credits any application fee to the fee destination you name and the net to the beneficiary @banza, and returns the completed settlement. The request carries no amount and no rate: a body carrying any pricing field is refused with PRICING_FIELD_NOT_ACCEPTED. The source must not be the PRIMARY account; a fee destination, when named, must be your own business account, and is required only when your pricing resolves a fee. Credential: developer key with application_settlements:write on a project with an ACTIVE binding, or a merchant credential. An unknown source account answers 404; a source account belonging to another owner answers 403 FORBIDDEN. Replaying the same idempotency_key for the same source and beneficiary returns the settlement it already made, with 200.

200.description: Idempotent replay: the settlement this idempotency_key already produced for the same source and beneficiary

201.description: Settlement executed (ledger posted). The response carries amounts and status only — never ledger account ids.

400.description: INVALID_BODY (not JSON, or over 64 KB), MISSING_FIELD (idempotency_key, source_account_id or beneficiary_banza_name), PRICING_FIELD_NOT_ACCEPTED (the body names a rate, profile, category or fee amount), or BAD_REQUEST forwarded from core

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing application_settlements:write), PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (project not provisioned to settle), FORBIDDEN (the source account belongs to another owner) or FEE_DESTINATION_NOT_OWNED (the fee destination is not your own business account)

404.description: Source account not found (NOT_FOUND)

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (the idempotency_key was already used for a different settlement), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, PRICING_NOT_CONFIGURED (Banzami has not assigned your business a pricing profile), PRICING_CONFIGURATION_ERROR, INVALID_STATUS; also IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT / IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED for the Idempotency-Key header

422.description: SOURCE_NOT_SEGREGATED (source is the PRIMARY account), BENEFICIARY_NOT_FOUND (no active wallet in this currency), NOTHING_TO_SETTLE (zero available balance), FEE_DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND, FEE_DESTINATION_REQUIRED (your pricing resolves a fee and no destination was named), FEE_DESTINATION_NOT_ACTIVE, FEE_DESTINATION_KYB_NOT_APPROVED, FEE_DESTINATION_WALLET_UNAVAILABLE, FEE_DESTINATION_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED, FEE_DESTINATION_NOT_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT, SANDBOX_VALUE_PERIMETER (a test Business settles only to a test payer or a test Business), FEE_EXCEEDS_GROSS, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, SETTLEMENT_NOT_COMPLETED

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE — the beneficiary, the fee destination or a prior settlement could not be checked right now; UPSTREAM_ERROR — the source account or pricing could not be resolved, or core failed. Retry with the same idempotency_key.

get.summary: Fetch an application settlement (merchant credential only)
get.description: Returns a settlement to the Business Account that created it; any other settlement, including one with no recorded creator, answers 404. Credential: merchant credential ONLY. The route sits on the dual-credential surface, but its handler reads only a merchant session, so a developer key is answered 401 UNAUTHORIZED — and there is no application_settlements:read scope. A project keeps the settlement returned by POST /v1/application-settlements.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED — no merchant session. Every developer key is answered this way.

404.description: Unknown settlement, or one created by another Business Account

get.summary: Retrieve one of your payment links
get.description: Returns a payment link by its id — the id returned at creation, not the public slug (a slug, or any id that is not a UUID, answers 404). Credential: developer key with payment_links:read on a project with an ACTIVE binding, or a merchant credential. Another project's link answers 404, indistinguishable from one that does not exist. refund_source is returned only to the owning merchant session, never to a developer key.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing payment_links:read) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (project not provisioned to accept payments)

404.description: Unknown or malformed id, or a link belonging to another project (NOT_FOUND)

delete.summary: Cancel one of your payment links
delete.description: Cancels an ACTIVE payment link so it can no longer be paid, and returns it with status CANCELLED. A link is marked paid only by a payment; to close an unpaid link, DELETE /v1/payment-links/{id}. Credential: developer key with payment_links:write on a project with an ACTIVE binding, or a merchant credential. Ownership is checked before anything changes: another project's link answers 404, indistinguishable from one that does not exist. A link that is no longer ACTIVE (USED, EXPIRED or CANCELLED) answers 422 LINK_NOT_ACTIVE.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing payment_links:write — a read-only key cannot cancel) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE

404.description: Unknown or malformed id, or a link belonging to another project (NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Idempotency-Key header: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (a request with this key is still in flight) or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (the key was already used for a different request body)

422.description: LINK_NOT_ACTIVE — the link was already used, expired or cancelled

get.description: Returns a refund of the owner your project is bound to. The read is scoped to that owner in Core: another project's refund, an unknown id and a malformed id all answer the same 404. Credential: developer key with refunds:read, or a merchant credential.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing refunds:read) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE

404.description: Unknown refund, or one belonging to another project (NOT_FOUND)

get.description: The consolidated profile of the Business Account behind a merchant session. It names that account's wallet and account ids, which a Project key must never learn, so a developer key is always refused with 403 USE_FINANCIAL_SETUP, whatever its scopes. A project reads the same readiness from GET /v1/financial-setup, which names none of them.

403.description: USE_FINANCIAL_SETUP — returned to every developer key; call GET /v1/financial-setup

503.description: UNAVAILABLE — the business profile service is not available

get.description: Resolves a consumer @banza to its handle and display name — enough to confirm a destination exists before naming it, and nothing more: no id, no wallet, no balance, no status. The lookup is exact after normalisation (a leading @ and upper case are accepted). Only consumer handles resolve here; a Business @banza answers 404. Credential: developer key with customers:read (no project binding required), or a merchant credential.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: The @banza, with or without the leading @

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE — missing customers:read

404.description: No consumer holds this handle (NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: Retrieve one of your webhook endpoints
get.description: Returns an endpoint of your project's owner, without its secret. Another project's endpoint answers 404, indistinguishable from one that does not exist. Credential: developer key with webhooks:read, or a merchant credential.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing webhooks:read) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (project not provisioned — an unbound project has no webhooks)

404.description: Unknown endpoint, or another project's endpoint (NOT_FOUND)

delete.summary: Deactivate one of your webhook endpoints
delete.description: Stops an endpoint receiving events. It is deactivated, not erased: it is retained for audit and still listed with active: false. Deactivating an already inactive endpoint answers 204 again. Another project's endpoint answers 404. Credential: developer key with webhooks:write, or a merchant credential.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing webhooks:write — a read-only key cannot change webhooks) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE

404.description: Unknown endpoint, or another project's endpoint (NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Idempotency-Key header: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (a request with this key is still in flight) or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (the key was already used for a different request body)

get.summary: Delivery health of one of your endpoints (last 24 hours)
get.description: Counts the endpoint's deliveries created in the last 24 hours by outcome. Another project's endpoint answers 404. Credential: developer key with webhooks:read, or a merchant credential.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing webhooks:read) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (project not provisioned — an unbound project has no webhooks)

404.description: Unknown endpoint, or another project's endpoint (NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Issues a new signing secret and returns it exactly once, in this response, as registration does. The cutover is immediate: the next delivery is signed with the new secret, while deliveries already queued keep their signature — update your receiver before rotating. No request body. Another project's endpoint answers 404. Credential: developer key with webhooks:write, or a merchant credential.

200.description: New secret issued. It appears here and nowhere else.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing webhooks:write — a read-only key cannot change webhooks) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE

404.description: Unknown endpoint, or another project's endpoint (NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Idempotency-Key header: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (a request with this key is still in flight) or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (the key was already used for a different request body)

get.description: Lists the events emitted for the owner your project is bound to, newest first, whether or not an endpoint received them. Credential: developer key with webhooks:read, or a merchant credential. There is no cursor: at most limit events are returned.

400.description: INVALID_PARAM — limit is not an integer between 1 and 100

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing webhooks:read) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (project not provisioned — an unbound project has no webhooks)

get.summary: Delivery history of one of your events
get.description: One delivery per endpoint the event was sent to, each with every attempt made (oldest first). Another project's event answers 404 — not an empty list. Credential: developer key with webhooks:read, or a merchant credential.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing webhooks:read) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (project not provisioned — an unbound project has no webhooks)

404.description: Unknown event, or another project's event (NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Puts an existing delivery back in the queue as PENDING, keeping its id — one delivery per event per endpoint, so a replay is a further attempt, never a second delivery. For recovery after an endpoint outage; a delivery that already succeeded answers 409 and is not sent again. No request body. Another project's delivery answers 404. Credential: developer key with webhooks:write, or a merchant credential.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing webhooks:write — a read-only key cannot change webhooks) or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE

404.description: Unknown delivery, or another project's delivery (NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Idempotency-Key header: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (a request with this key is still in flight) or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (the key was already used for a different request body)

429.description: WEBHOOK_TEST_RATE_LIMITED — a replay of a test delivery counts toward the endpoint's 10 test deliveries a minute; wait for Retry-After

get.summary: Verify a receipt by its public proof reference
get.description: Public and unauthenticated: the reference is the capability. The current format is SECURE_V1 — BZM- followed by six groups of four symbols from 0-9 and A-Z without I, L, O and U (120 bits). Older eight-symbol references (BZM-XXXX-XXXX) still verify. Matching is EXACT: there is no normalisation, so lower-case letters, spaces or an extra hyphen answer 404 exactly like a reference that does not exist, on purpose. The same verification is the page https://banzami.com/r/{ref} that a receipt QR opens. Rate-limited per client. This is not the eight-character reference the Banzami app shows on a transfer, which is a display aid and does not verify.

404.description: No such receipt, or the reference was altered. Indistinguishable by design.

429.description: Too many verifications from this client. Honour Retry-After.

503.description: Verification is temporarily unavailable. Do not conclude the receipt is forged.

get.description: How to produce each Sandbox outcome, what comes back and which event follows. Every scenario comes from a real operation, except external-rail outcomes, which are requested with simulate and marked simulated: true. There are no magic amounts. Credential: Sandbox project key with sandbox:read.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (the key lacks sandbox:read) or SANDBOX_ONLY (not a Sandbox key — test data exists only in the Sandbox)

post.description: Creates a Sandbox consumer owned by your Project, with a wallet and a fictitious opening balance. A test payer acts only through this API: it pays the Project's own sessions and links and signs in to no app. At most 10 active test payers per Project. Credential: Sandbox project key with sandbox:write.

400.description: INVALID_BODY or INVALID_PARAM (label over 60 characters; initial_balance_minor outside 0–1000000)

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (the key lacks sandbox:write) or SANDBOX_ONLY (not a Sandbox key — test data exists only in the Sandbox)

409.description: Idempotency-Key header: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (a request with this key is still in flight) or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (the key was already used for a different request body)

422.description: SANDBOX_FUNDING_REFUSED — the opening balance was refused by the payer's balance limit

get.description: Your Project's test payers, newest first, with their current fictitious balance. Credential: Sandbox project key with sandbox:read.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (the key lacks sandbox:read) or SANDBOX_ONLY (not a Sandbox key — test data exists only in the Sandbox)

get.description: One of your Project's test payers. Another Project's payer answers 404. Credential: Sandbox project key with sandbox:read.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (the key lacks sandbox:read) or SANDBOX_ONLY (not a Sandbox key — test data exists only in the Sandbox)

404.description: NOT_FOUND — unknown, or another Project's

delete.description: Retires the payer: its fictitious balance is retired through the ledger and it can no longer pay or be funded. Nothing is deleted; its payments and history stay readable. Credential: Sandbox project key with sandbox:write.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (the key lacks sandbox:write) or SANDBOX_ONLY (not a Sandbox key — test data exists only in the Sandbox)

404.description: NOT_FOUND — unknown, or another Project's

503.description: RETIREMENT_FAILED — not fully retired this time; repeat the request

post.summary: Add fictitious value to a test payer
post.description: A fictitious top-up through the ledger — never a balance edit. The Idempotency-Key header is required and identifies the top-up. Limits: 2500000 per top-up, a 5000000 payer balance, and 20 top-ups and 10000000 per Project per 24 hours. Credential: Sandbox project key with sandbox:write.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. The same key never funds twice.

200.description: Funded (or the replay of the same top-up)

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (the key lacks sandbox:write) or SANDBOX_ONLY (not a Sandbox key — test data exists only in the Sandbox)

404.description: NOT_FOUND — unknown, or another Project's

409.description: Idempotency-Key header: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (a request with this key is still in flight) or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (the key was already used for a different request body)

422.description: TEST_PAYER_RETIRED or SANDBOX_FUNDING_REFUSED (the payer's balance limit)

post.description: Pays one of your own Payment Sessions (by its link or dynamic QR) or Payment Links as this test payer. Without simulate it is a wallet payment: value moves from the test payer's wallet to your Business inside Banzami, through the same path a real payer uses — the session becomes PAID, payment_session.paid is emitted and a receipt is issued — and it does not depend on any external rail (rail: WALLET). simulate stands in for a payment whose funds cross an external rail and requests that rail's outcome explicitly (rail: EXTERNAL_SIMULATED); if your Business's Sandbox external rail is UNAVAILABLE, such a payment answers 503 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE and nothing moves. Credential: Sandbox project key with sandbox:write. simulate DELAYED answers 202 PENDING and completes about 10 seconds later.

202.description: PENDING — simulate DELAYED: accepted, not yet complete. The payment completes on its own about 10 seconds later (the session becomes PAID and payment_session.paid is sent); a repeat with the same Idempotency-Key answers 202 until then and 200 with the result afterwards.

example.message: Sandbox simulation: accepted and not yet complete.

400.description: INVALID_BODY; INVALID_PARAM (not exactly one target, via not LINK/QR, unknown simulate); IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED (simulate TIMEOUT without a key)

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE, SANDBOX_ONLY, or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (the Project has no Financial Setup)

404.description: NOT_FOUND — the payer, session or link is unknown or another Project's; QR_NOT_FOUND

409.description: LINK_ALREADY_PAID; or the Idempotency-Key header: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT / IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED

422.description: INTERFACE_UNAVAILABLE, TEST_PAYER_RETIRED, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, LINK_NOT_ACTIVE, QR_EXPIRED, QR_ALREADY_USED, AMOUNT_NEGATIVE, INVALID_WALLET_ACCOUNT, WALLET_NOT_FOUND or ACCOUNT_FROZEN

503.description: PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE — simulate PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, or any simulate while your project's Sandbox external rail is UNAVAILABLE; nothing moved (Retry-After). SANDBOX_SIMULATED_TIMEOUT — simulate TIMEOUT; the payment was made; repeat with the same Idempotency-Key to read it. Tell them apart by code. PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED — the money moved but completion was not confirmed; repeat the same request.

post.summary: Send a test event to an endpoint
post.description: Sandbox only. Creates a synthetic webhook.test event (synthetic: true) and delivers it to this endpoint, signed like any other event, so you can check your receiver and signature verification. It describes no payment and moves nothing; it is not one of the subscribable events, and its delivery can be replayed even after success. Follow it with listWebhookDeliveries. No request body. Credential: Sandbox project key with webhooks:write.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (missing webhooks:write), PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE, or SANDBOX_ONLY (test events exist only in the Sandbox)

404.description: NOT_FOUND — unknown, or another Project's endpoint

429.description: WEBHOOK_TEST_RATE_LIMITED — at most 10 test deliveries a minute to one endpoint (sends and replays together); wait for Retry-After

get.description: For a browser page. With Accept: text/event-stream, a Server-Sent Events stream: retry, then a snapshot event with the current status, a status event on each change, a ': heartbeat' comment every 5 seconds, and an expired event when the token expires. The stream closes after a terminal status (PAID, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, FAILED). A reconnect starts again from a fresh snapshot. With Accept: application/json, one snapshot. Open it with fetch and the token in the Authorization header — not EventSource, which cannot send it, and never with the token in the URL. Realtime status is for the screen, not proof of payment: fulfil on the signed payment_session.paid webhook or a GET made by your backend. CORS: any origin, no cookies. Limits: 3 streams per session, 20 per IP, 120 requests per minute per IP; a closed stream frees its place within one heartbeat, and a 429 carries Retry-After.

text/event-stream.example:
retry: 3000

id: ACTIVE-1
event: snapshot
data: {"session_id":"payment_session_xxx","status":"ACTIVE","amount_minor":250000,"currency":"AOA","expires_at":"2026-09-14T11:00:00Z","terminal":false,"observed_at":"2026-09-14T10:04:00Z"}

: heartbeat

id: PAID-2
event: status

400.description: REALTIME_TOKEN_IN_URL — the token was sent in the query string; it is refused there even when valid

401.description: REALTIME_TOKEN_REQUIRED, REALTIME_TOKEN_INVALID or REALTIME_TOKEN_EXPIRED — read the session on your backend for a new token

403.description: REALTIME_TOKEN_WRONG_RESOURCE — the token is for another Payment Session

404.description: NOT_FOUND — the session no longer exists

406.description: STREAMING_UNSUPPORTED — ask for application/json and try the stream again later

429.description: REALTIME_STREAM_LIMIT (3 per session, 20 per IP) or RATE_LIMITED

503.description: REALTIME_UNAVAILABLE — fall back to GET on your backend at a modest interval

get.summary: Read your Project's Sandbox external rail
get.description: The simulated external rail your project uses for its Sandbox Business. Banzami is rail-decoupled: value already inside the network moves through Banzami Core and its ledger without an external rail; an external rail is crossed only where value enters or leaves the network. Credential: Sandbox project key with sandbox:read.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE, SANDBOX_ONLY, or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (the project has no Financial Setup, so no Business and no rail)

put.summary: Take your Project's Sandbox external rail down, or bring it back
put.description: Sets the simulated external rail your project uses for its Sandbox Business. With UNAVAILABLE, a test payer's wallet payment to your Business still completes; a payment with simulate, and a payment started on the hosted page of a session or link this project created, answer 503 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE with nothing moved. It affects only this project: another project connected to the same Business keeps its own rail. Credential: Sandbox project key with sandbox:write.

400.description: INVALID_BODY; INVALID_PARAM (state is not AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE)

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE, SANDBOX_ONLY, or PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (the project has no Financial Setup, so no Business and no rail)

bearerAuth.description: Sandbox API key sent directly as the Bearer token (bz_test_sk_XXXX placeholder — never a real key in examples). bz_live_ keys are rejected fail-closed; there is no Production key issuance.

statusToken.description: A realtime status token (bzst_…) from PaymentSession.realtime.token. Read-only, bound to one Payment Session and one environment, valid for at most 30 minutes. Sent only in the Authorization header — a token in the URL is refused (400 REALTIME_TOKEN_IN_URL). It is not an API key and opens nothing else.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Send on writes to retry safely. Sandbox behaviour: the original 2xx/4xx response is replayed for the same key for 24 hours (scoped per credential, method and path); 5xx responses are never replayed; concurrent requests with the same key receive 409 CONFLICT until the first completes.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request (codes: INVALID_BODY, MISSING_FIELD, VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_PARAM, INVALID_AMOUNT)

example.message: amount_minor must be a positive integer

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or revoked key (code UNAUTHORIZED)

example.message: a valid Sandbox API key is required

Forbidden.description: Insufficient scope or project without an active binding (code FORBIDDEN)

NotFound.description: Resource missing or outside your scope (code NOT_FOUND)

Conflict.description: Idempotency-Key in flight or state conflict (code CONFLICT)

example.message: a request with this Idempotency-Key is already in progress — retry after it completes

Error.description: Canonical flat error envelope returned by every failing endpoint (observed Sandbox behaviour). Handle errors by code, never by message; keep request_id for support correlation.

code.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE error code (e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, RATE_LIMITED, INTERNAL_ERROR)

message.description: Human-readable message (not stable — do not branch on it)

request_id.description: Correlation id for support (placeholder req_xxx in examples)

environment.description: Always SANDBOX — there is no Production surface

wallet_account_id.description:
Which segregated account under YOUR owner receives the payment.

With a Developer Platform key: optional. Omit it and the payment credits your project's default account. Supply one of your own accounts to segregate (e.g. per campaign); an account belonging to another owner returns 404.

You may never name the OWNER: merchant_id, wallet_id, payee, payee_id and payee_wallet are rejected with 400 PAYEE_NOT_ALLOWED. The owner comes from your project's binding.

With a merchant credential: required.

value.description: For the QR interfaces, the hosted pay URL the QR encodes (https://pay.banzami.com/pay/{slug}).

PaymentSessionInterface.description: One presentation of a payment session. Every interface resolves to the same session and credits the same wallet account. PAYMENT_LINK and DEEP_LINK carry URLs; DYNAMIC_QR (fixed amount) and STATIC_QR (open amount) carry the string to encode in the QR, which is the session's hosted pay URL. qr_url is the API path that renders that QR.

refund_source.description: Merchant-safe refund source; present only once the payment has settled

wallet_id.description: Merchant credential ONLY. With a Developer Platform key the wallet is derived from your project's binding and supplying this returns 400 PAYEE_NOT_ALLOWED — even when the value is your own wallet.

purpose.description: Account purpose. PRIMARY is provisioned with the wallet and cannot be created.

source_wallet_account_id.description: Source account. Must belong to your bound owner.

destination_wallet_account_id.description: Destination account. Must belong to your bound owner and differ from the source.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (AOA). Zero and negative are refused.

idempotency_key.description: Required. Without it every retry would be a new transfer.

amount_minor.description: Up to the source’s accrued cap.

url.description: Public https destination. http, loopback, private and link-local addresses are refused.

events.description: Supported event types only; an unknown name is refused rather than silently accepted.

secret.description: Returned exactly once, on creation. Never readable again — a later read omits it.

ProjectRef.description: The Project an API key belongs to. Nothing behind the Project (workspace, key, financial owner, wallet or account) is ever named.

id.description: The Project's own id, as shown in the Developers Console. Stable across renames.

ref.description: The Project slug. Human-readable; changes when the Project is renamed.

SettlementBlocker.description: Why the Project cannot settle yet. Each is the refusal a settlement would return. The set can grow: treat an unknown value as blocking.

FinancialSetupResponse.description: A Project's own financial readiness. Every field is decided with the rules settlement enforces: settlement.ready is true exactly when settlement's prerequisites pass. Contains no internal identifier.

state.description: UNCONFIGURED: no financial owner yet (every Project starts here). READY: configured. SEALED: configured and fixed, because a payer-facing artifact was issued against it.

pricing.description: Assigned by Banzami. A settlement request never carries a rate.

fee_destination.description: Where an application fee would be credited: the Project's own @banza, or the one named with ?fee_destination.

required.description: Whether the assigned pricing charges a fee at all. When false the destination blocks nothing.

type_allowed.description: The account is classified by Banzami as one that may receive an application fee.

application_account_ready.description: The fee is credited to the destination's own account (no separate application account exists); true when that account can receive.

onboarding.description: Where the Project stands in getting a Business to receive into. A Project applies for a new Business (reviewed by Banzami) or connects an existing one with that Business's consent, in the Developers Console. While the Project has no Business, the application's status and the requested @banza are included — never the application's contents.

CreateApplicationSettlementRequest.description: Names what to settle and who receives it — never how much, and never the rate. A body carrying any pricing field is refused.

source_account_id.description: A segregated wallet account of your own owner (for example a CAMPAIGN account) — not the PRIMARY account. Its whole available balance is settled.

beneficiary_banza_name.description: The @banza that receives the net, with or without the leading @. Must have an active wallet in the source currency.

fee_destination_banza_name.description: Your own business @banza that receives an application fee. Required only when the pricing Banzami assigned you resolves a fee.

reference_id.description: Your reference for the settlement; returned as owner_ref.

reason.description: Free text; used as owner_ref when reference_id is absent.

reference_type.description: Accepted and currently not stored or returned.

idempotency_key.description: Required. The same key for the same source and beneficiary returns the settlement it already made; the same key for anything else is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

ApplicationSettlement.description: The app-facing view of a settlement: amounts and status only. Ledger account ids, the source and the beneficiary account are never included.

owner_ref.description: Your reference_id, or reason when no reference_id was sent

gross_amount_minor.description: The source account's available balance when the settlement ran

pricing.description: The operator's pricing as applied to THIS settlement, from the snapshot stored with it — repricing a profile later does not change it.

PaymentLinkRecord.description: A payment link as its owner reads it (GET and DELETE /v1/payment-links/{id}). The owner's id is never included for a developer key.

id.description: The link's id — use it with /v1/payment-links/{id}

wallet_account_id.description: The account the link credits; empty when none was set

HandleResolution.description: Confirms a @banza exists. Nothing else about the account is disclosed.

handle.description: The handle as registered (lower case, no leading @)

WebhookEndpointHealth.description: Deliveries to one endpoint created in the last 24 hours.

last_delivered_at.description: Omitted when nothing was delivered in the window

last_failed_at.description: Omitted when nothing failed in the window

WebhookEvent.description: An emitted event. payload is the event envelope {id, type, created_at, data} as it is delivered, except that the owner's id is removed for a developer key.

synthetic.description: true for a Sandbox test event (webhook.test): it describes no payment and moves nothing; its deliveries can be replayed even after success.

status_code.description: null when no HTTP response arrived

error_class.description: http_status, timeout, connection, tls, dns or other

WebhookDelivery.description: One event's delivery to one endpoint. Retries are its attempts, not further deliveries.

attempt_number.description: How many attempts have been made so far

status_code.description: The receiver's last HTTP status; omitted before any response

response_body.description: The receiver's last response body; omitted when empty

attempts.description: Every recorded attempt, oldest first. Attempts made before attempt history existed are counted in attempt_number but not listed. null on the replay response.

PublicProof.description: The public projection of a verified receipt. Holding the reference is the only authority this read needs, so treat a proof reference as a bearer capability.

status.description: A refunded or reversed payment keeps its receipt and becomes REVERSED; receipts are never deleted.

PaymentSessionRealtime.description: A realtime status token for watching this session from a browser. Present on reads made with a project key. Hand token to the page; the page sends it in the Authorization header. Refresh by reading the session again on your backend.

RealtimeStatus.description: The public status of one Payment Session. No payer, payee, account or ledger identifiers.

terminal.description: true for PAID, EXPIRED, CANCELLED and FAILED; a stream closes after sending it

simulated.description: true only for an external-rail outcome requested with simulate

TestPayer.description: A Sandbox consumer owned by your Project, with fictitious value.

PayAsTestPayerRequest.description: Name exactly one of payment_session_id or payment_link_id. Both must be your Project's own.

via.description: For a session: LINK (default) or QR

simulate.description: An external-rail outcome, requested explicitly. DECLINED and PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE move nothing. TIMEOUT pays and answers 503 SANDBOX_SIMULATED_TIMEOUT; repeat with the same Idempotency-Key to read the real result. DELAYED answers 202 PENDING and completes the payment on its own about 10 seconds later.

proof_reference.description: The receipt's BZM-… reference, when its proof was established in time

rail.description: WALLET: value moved inside Banzami from the test payer's wallet and needed no external rail. EXTERNAL_SIMULATED: the payment stood in for one that crosses an external rail (simulate).

SimulatedError.description: The error envelope of a Sandbox simulation, marked simulated: true.

TestPaymentPending.description: A test payment accepted with simulate DELAYED and not yet complete.

state.description: AVAILABLE: operations that cross an external rail proceed. UNAVAILABLE: they fail closed with 503 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE and nothing is created, credited or confirmed. Movements inside Banzami (wallet payments, refunds of wallet payments, settlements) are never affected.
